species.name: Falcon
mustRead: dark malar moustache stripe below the eye
long pointed swept wingtips reaching the tail
species.note: Wings are narrow and scythe-like, not broad and rounded like a hawk's.

species.name: Egret
mustRead: thin spear bill and long dark legs

species.name: Ibis
mustRead: long neck held out and long legs

species.name: Stork
mustRead: neck held straight rather than kinked
species.note: Unlike a heron, the stork flies and stands with its neck extended straight.

species.name: Ostrich
mustRead: extremely long bare neck with a tiny flat head
fluffy plume wings and tail bustle

species.name: Secretary Bird
mustRead: crest of long black quill feathers behind the head
eagle head with a bare orange-red face

species.name: Crane
mustRead: drooping bustle of tail plumes over the rump
bare red crown patch and stilt legs
species.note: Neck is straight, not S-kinked like a heron's, and the bill is shorter.

species.name: Spoonbill
mustRead: long flat bill flaring into a rounded spatula at the tip

species.name: Flamingo
mustRead: neck kinked into a long S
thick bill bent sharply downward at the middle
extremely long pink legs with a backward-bending ankle
species.note: The 'backward knee' is the ankle. Bill points down when feeding, held upside down in the water.

species.name: Lark
mustRead: slight peaked crest at the back of the crown
species.note: Generic name read as a representative skylark-type lark: a horizontal, long-bodied songbird, not an upright perching finch.

species.name: Bustard
mustRead: heavy horizontal body carried high on long bare legs
flat-crowned head with a short stout bill

species.name: Sandgrouse
mustRead: plump pigeon-like body on very short feathered legs
small head on a short neck

species.name: Rhea
mustRead: long bare neck and long bare legs
shaggy drooping wings with no visible tail
small flat head with a broad blunt bill
species.note: Taller than long: total height is dominated by neck and legs. Three toes, not two like an ostrich.

species.name: Seriema
mustRead: spray of erect bristly feathers at the base of the bill

species.name: Finch
species.note: Generic name read as a representative small seed-eating finch.

species.name: Swallow
mustRead: deeply forked tail with long outer streamers
tiny flat bill with a wide gape

species.name: Quail
mustRead: round plump body like a feathered ball
very short tail and short legs
small head tucked close to the body

species.name: Magpie
mustRead: very long graduated wedge tail longer than the body

species.name: Jay
mustRead: stout crow-like bill on a rounded head

species.name: Partridge
mustRead: small head with a short curved bill

species.name: Dove
mustRead: small round head on a plump breast
short slender bill with a fleshy cere

species.name: Curlew
mustRead: streaked brown body on a small round head
species.note: The bill can be a quarter of the total profile length; drawing it short or straight destroys the identification.
